💎Driving along the beautiful city roads: Kraków is easily Poland's best destination: a beautiful, old-fashioned city buzzing with enjoyable sights, tourists, and college students, and some heavy history (nearby lies the Holocaust memorial and museum of Auschwitz). Often voted one of Europe’s most beautiful cities, Kraków was the first UNESCO World Heritage Site in the world. The city was the capital of Poland for a long time and for many people it is still the secret capital of the country. After Warsaw, Krakow is now the second largest city in Poland with nearly 800,000 inhabitants. 🏰🚗

⚠️I encountered some technical issues due to inappropriate camera settings, which are noticeable in certain frames. Unfortunately, I didn't have time for a remake. Nevertheless, the majority of the frames remain unaffected, featuring good visuals of famous landmarks such as Wawel Castle, Kraków Barbican, Oskar Schindler's Enamel Factory, etc. That's why I decided to upload this video, especially for those curious about the lively streets of Krakow. In the near future, I plan to create a remake with optimal visuals.

👉Thinking about visiting Krakow too? Discover the most affordable flights with extra discounts here: https://kiwi.tp.st/7n0D9hcM

💎There is no music and no talking. Only road noise. Traffic is moderate. Enjoy the Krakow Drive!🛣️
